resources.string: Standard memory uses GLOBAL.md and daily logs. Advanced memory keeps core long-term information and episode summaries of experiences for retrieval. Switching modes keeps existing records. Turning advanced memory off folds its settings, records, tests and maintenance; turn it on again to manage them. It does not automatically import GLOBAL.md, daily logs or previous chats, and is not a chat-history search. Manual additions and edits are protected from automatic replacement; deleted source episodes are not recreated automatically.

The summarization model extracts memories from eligible conversations and requires API-key authentication. The embedding model requires API-key authentication and an OpenAI-compatible /embeddings endpoint; OAuth, Azure, Anthropic and Gemini-specific endpoints are not supported for embeddings. A chat model may not support embeddings. Likely embedding models appear first based on names or advertised capabilities, not API verification. Changing the embedding model requires reindexing. Records without a matching index fall back to local keyword search. Summarization sends conversation text, indexing sends memory text, and semantic tests send the query to the selected provider; requests may incur charges.
No eligible models. Add or enable a provider and model in Providers settings.

Range 0–1: higher is stricter. Unrelated records are not added just to fill the result count. Scores indicate relevance, not factual accuracy. Use the threshold test to check results before adjusting.

Off by default. Requires advanced memory, a summarization model, and memory enabled for the session. After an eligible chat becomes idle for the configured delay, its visible user and assistant text can be summarized. Only chats used after opt-in are eligible; previous chats are not backfilled. This switch controls consolidation, not recall. Tool output, hidden reasoning and file contents are excluded.

Enable automatic consolidation for eligible chats used after this opt-in? After the idle delay, visible user and assistant text is sent to your selected summarization provider and may incur charges. Tools, hidden reasoning, and files are excluded. Previous chats are not scanned or processed automatically. You can turn this off at any time.
Operation cancelled. Completed items are retained.
Saved locally and protected from automatic replacement. Rebuild the vector index after saving.
Delete this record permanently? Its content and vector will be removed. A source-session marker is retained to prevent automatic recreation. This cannot be undone.

Shows returned candidates, including rejected candidates and their reasons. Maximum recall count limits accepted results, not the number of candidates in this test; search safety limits still apply. Results are never inserted into a chat. Test again after changing settings or records. Turning advanced memory off hides this test; turn it on again to use it.
On: sends the query to the embedding provider when testing; charges may apply. Off: local search only.
Threshold used for this test: %1$.2f. Run again after changing settings or records.
No candidates. Nothing is forced into recall.
Embedding failed; showing local lexical results only: %1$s

Send stored advanced-memory text to the selected embedding provider to rebuild its vector index? This may incur cloud charges. Text remains local in the canonical store. You can cancel the operation; completed items are retained. Standard memory files and old chats are not imported.

Send eligible visible user and assistant text from session %1$s to the selected summarization provider? This may incur charges and creates or updates its episode summary. Hidden reasoning, tool output, and files are excluded. Manual or deleted source episodes are not overwritten.
This record changed or was deleted. Close and reopen it before trying again.
Conversation text is sent to the summarization provider; charges may apply.
